projectDescription: A collection of 352 self-contained offline HTML games with a full-featured browser-based hub interface, tools for running games in restricted environments, and utilities for inlining web content into single files.
keyFeatures: 352 self-contained offline HTML games playable without internet
CXSHS Game Hub — a tabbed browser-style launcher with rail nav, search, and theme engine
8 visual themes (Halloween, Cherry, Pink, Teal, Green, Blue, Purple, Black) with animated transitions
Favorites, Recent, and Search/Sort within the game library
Multi-tab system (up to 8 tabs) with per-tab history and animated view transitions
Built-in apps: Music player, Notes, Clock/Stopwatch, Settings, All Apps
Epic Viewer — a browser-based HTML code editor/runner with IndexedDB snippet storage and chunk mode
File Input tool — drag-and-drop HTML file runner with fullscreen support
Single-file.html — a standalone offline game launcher with zip import support (JSZip 3.10.1)
Inline-tools collection for converting web pages to self-contained offline HTML files
chunks.py — Python utility to split large HTML files into smaller parts
Methods guides for running games on ChromeOS and through school platforms (Canvas, Code.org, CodeHS, Pear Deck)
publicApiSurface: index.html — main CXSHS Game Hub launcher
epicviewer.htm — HTML code editor/runner with IndexedDB snippet storage
offline/*.html — 352 individual self-contained offline game files
inline-tools/full_inliner.html — converts online pages to offline single-file HTML
inline-tools/html-to-offline.html — converts an existing HTML page to offline format
inline-tools/blob.html / blob-compressed.html / compressed.html — alternate inlining variants
inline-tools/convertfilestodatauris.py — Python script to convert files to Data URIs
chunks.py — splits large HTML files into numbered parts
